result.summary: Found 3 visible issues: horizontally clipped carousel content, an awkward partially visible category chip, and a questionable discount label.

issues.description: The rightmost restaurant card in the “Fastest near you” row is cut off, including its restaurant name and delivery details.
issues.suggestion: Ensure the horizontal carousel has intentional peek spacing and adequate right padding, or snap cards so partially displayed text is not clipped.

issues.description: A nearly empty fragment of the next category pill is visible at the far-right edge of the category row, making the row look accidentally cropped.
issues.suggestion: Adjust the carousel position, chip widths, or viewport padding so the next chip shows enough content to be recognizable or remains fully off-screen.

issues.description: The “−100%” promotion badge is ambiguous and looks like an erroneous discount value.
issues.suggestion: Use clearer wording such as “100% off” or “Free,” and verify that the promotion data is correct.
